title: Smoked Fish Pancakes
description: Delicious pancakes filled with smoked fish and scallions, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: hakka pancake mix
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: smoked fish
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together hakka pancake mix and salt.
Add chopped scallion and mix well.
Add smoked fish and mix until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the pan.
Fry the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and fry for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve hot with hot sauce on the side, if desired.
